notes.title: The Dungeon Beckons!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25722524/7c8c36eeb4529261fd7501cc12c7144f653b83e3.png[/img]
Thank you for waiting - Dungeon Girl is now available to play! 

Just hop on in and head into the dungeon to begin your exploration! With an estimated playtime of over 50 hours to complete, there are many friends to make along your way.

The cute puzzle RPG by Inu to Neko comes with English and Japanese language support.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25722524/a88a2abd91db1236d0d9ee940ba4322f55a166c2.png[/img]

Features:
[list][*]A strategic Puzzle RPG
[*]1000 floors to explore
[*]300 items to craft
[*]200 skills to use[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25722524/a0dbb4f074fd5fa8230c71bad4a08de27d25b27b.png[/img]

The game also includes Steam achievements, Cloud support and Trading Cards!

Happy exploration!

notes.title: Dungeon Girl Releasing July 30!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our testing has progressed well and we're now happy to announce a Steam release date for Dungeon Girl: this cute puzzle RPG is hitting Steam on July 30 - in only 2 more weeks!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25722524/e8b81aace5c853ec1914a80e3b590beaf28a1c27.png[/img]

Join Monica on her journey into the dungeon under the Tower of Light Blue, and conquer its 1000 floors! 

Dungeon Girl is part of the shared universe of Inu to Neko’s imaginative fantasy games. With numerous engaging mechanics from puzzle combat to item crafting and resource management, it offers more than 50 hours of estimated playtime for those who want to explore everything it has to offer. Just go one floor lower… but watch out for the bosses lying in wait!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25722524/dd4d30333b644a446b7a38adb24e5180f6d46845.png[/img]

New screenshots have also been added on the store page, please check them out!

notes.title: Dungeon Girl Moves into Testing
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25722524/98bef85782100f7c6e6ac60fdbcd2c9cc7b6e522.png[/img]
Thank you for your patience! We're happy to share with you some good news on the progress on Dungeon Girl: we've finally been able to work around the technical issues delaying the release, and the game is now moving into testing! We expect a release date to follow shortly.

Steam page has also been updated with a full set of new screenshots, so please head on over to take a look!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25722524/cf3978ef34b9f16726d35e30dc5167b6b87b2eb8.png[/img]

With 1000 floors to explore, many friends to make and hundreds of items to craft, Dungeon Girl will have fun for all players!
